candidate.name: dual_gaussian_bias_localization_pcaf_alarm
candidate.localization_equation: L(p)=sum_v g(r_v(p))*(s_v(p)-b(r_v(p)))/sum_v g(r_v(p)); g is the fixed nnU-Net Gaussian with sigma_scale=1/8 and b is the source-normal crop-coordinate median
candidate.alarm_equation: A(I)=top_fraction_mean(score_modes(PCAF(I))); the parent threshold is fitted from source-normal parents exactly as in frozen PCAF
candidate.logic: Localization and parent alarming are distinct estimands. The localization map is never reused to redefine the parent alarm, and the PCAF alarm is never used to alter pixel ranks.
candidate.runtime: Both readouts reuse the same 73 frozen detector crop maps; the candidate adds no crop scoring, training, or GPU model.

development_record.status: development evidence known before this K2 preregistration
development_record.interpretation: Rollo4A may verify implementation identity but is not independent confirmation and must not select another window, score mode, blend, or alarm readout.

confirmation.support_condition: On the six untouched confirmation rolls, the fixed dual readout must exceed the strongest reference macro Pixel AP by at least 0.001, remain within 0.002 all-instance AUC of the strongest reference, beat the best reference on at least four rolls, and reproduce every PCAF parent score and operating-point metric exactly. All six rolls are reported.
confirmation.strong_pareto_condition: In addition to exact PCAF parent alarming, confirmation macro Pixel AP and all-instance AUC must both exceed the corresponding strongest reference values.

prohibited_after_results: changing Gaussian to Hann or another window
selecting a score mode other than robust_z
tuning thresholds on target-normal or defective parents

provenance.development_disclosure: Gaussian plus coordinate-bias localization was observed on Rollo4A in K1 before K2 was defined; the other six rolls have not been evaluated for this localization readout.
provenance.prior_covariance_boundary: Exact-signature correlated PCAF and its nonnegative GLS variant were already tested on Rollo4A. Their normalized weights are invariant to an additive common covariance c*11^T, but both reduced Pixel AP and failed frozen stability/performance gates. K2 does not tune or rescue those closed covariance estimators; it tests the distinct hypothesis that localization and parent alarming require separate readouts.

geometric_fusion.hard_center_tie_rule: equal mean among observations tied for maximum boundary distance

context_response_calibration.score: pattern-conditional empirical upper-tail of one-sided robust residual energy
context_response_calibration.physical_field_estimator: inverse-robust-variance weighted mean after crop-relative median bias removal

ablation_estimators.context_bias_equal_mean: equal mean after crop-relative median bias removal
ablation_estimators.context_scale_weighted_mean: inverse-robust-variance weighted raw response without bias removal
